name: pepper-chicken-rice
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: standalone food cover photograph for a Chinese food community and delivery app.
Primary request: A ceramic rice bowl of Sichuan pepper chicken: bite-sized seared chicken pieces and red dried chili peppers over white rice, on a warm wooden table. Real grains and natural glossy sauce, believable serving size.
Style/medium: photorealistic natural editorial food photography, warm inviting everyday realism, not advertising gloss.
Composition/framing: square photograph, one scene only, slight overhead three-quarter view, primary dish centered with full plate or bowl edges visible and sufficient margin to survive square or portrait cover cropping. Food dominates frame without clipping the dish.
Lighting/mood: soft natural window daylight, realistic shadows and colors, subtle depth of field.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no coffee, no collage, no pixel art, no illustration, no plastic-looking food, no distorted or duplicated tableware.
